name: Negative — file read with error handling
diff:
diff --git a/reader.go b/reader.go
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/reader.go
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+package main
+
+import "os"
+
+func readConfig(path string) ([]byte, error) {
+	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	return data, nil
+}
